_readme: Extraction benchmark corpus. Each case is a piece of source text plus the
events a human says are genuinely in it.
IMPORTANT: the cases below are SYNTHETIC SEEDS, written to cover the failure
modes the prompt was designed against (deadline vs event, schedule grids,
vague dates that must NOT be resolved, notes scattered away from the item,
and text containing no events at all). They are not real family paperwork.
To make this benchmark meaningful, add REAL cases: paste the text of a flyer
or email you have actually received, label the events by hand, and keep it.
Ten real cases are worth more than fifty invented ones. Strip surnames,
addresses and phone numbers before saving anything here -- this file goes
'today' fixes the reference date so relative-date behaviour is reproducible.
Fields left out of an expected event are expected to be null.

cases.note: A form due is a deadline; the thing you attend is an event. Both are here.
cases.source:
CHAPEL LAKES ELEMENTARY — Fall Volleyball

Tryouts begin Monday, August 24 at 4:00 PM in the North Gym.
All athletes must have a completed physical form on file. Forms are due to the front office no later than Friday, August 21.
Bring water, athletic shoes and a completed form. Questions: coach Alvarez.

expected.title: Physical form due
expected.notes: Completed physical form due to the front office; required before tryouts.

expected.title: Volleyball Tryouts
expected.notes: Bring water, athletic shoes and a completed physical form.

cases.note: THE most important case. 'Later this fall' is not a date. A model that invents one has failed, even though the invented date looks plausible.
cases.source:
PTA Newsletter

The book fair returns later this fall — dates to be announced.
Picture day is Wednesday, September 9. Order envelopes went home Tuesday; exact change only.
We are still looking for volunteers for the fall festival sometime in October.

expected.title: Picture Day
expected.notes: Order envelopes went home Tuesday; exact change only.

cases.note: The date is on the flyer, what to bring is three paragraphs away. A good extraction joins them.
cases.source:
Subject: Field trip — Thursday

Hi families,

Our trip to the science museum is Thursday, September 3. The bus leaves at 8:15 AM sharp from the front loop.

A reminder that permission slips were due last week — if you have not sent one, your child cannot ride.

Students should wear their class t-shirt and closed-toe shoes, and bring a sack lunch in a disposable bag. No money is needed; admission is covered.

expected.title: Science museum field trip
expected.notes: Bus leaves 8:15 AM sharp; wear class t-shirt and closed-toe shoes; bring a sack lunch in a disposable bag; no money needed; permission slip required to ride.

cases.note: A range must produce both a start and an end.
cases.source: Open House — Tuesday, September 8, 6:00-8:30 PM in the cafeteria. Drop in any time.

cases.note: The negative case, and the one most likely to expose a model that wants to be helpful. Correct output is an empty list.
cases.source: Thank you to everyone who helped at last week's fun run! We raised more than expected and the kids had a wonderful time. Photos are on the school website. Have a great weekend.

cases.note: The source gives both a weekday and a date. The prompt says the DATE wins.
cases.source: Band practice moves to Wenesday 9/2 at 3:30 in the band room. Bring your folder.

cases.note: Same date, different items. Tests that pairing does not collapse them.
